title: WaveBeginRequest
description: The choice the owner took on the wave's start card, and the wave's slices.

choice.description: build goes on to build the slices; build-over drops the branches an earlier run left first; stop ends the run before anything is cut.

slices.description: The wave's slices, whose kept tests are forgotten if the run fails after this step.

leftovers.description: Each branch an earlier run of the wave left, as the step wave found it.

branch.description: The branch an earlier run left.

commit.description: The commit it points at, in full.

into.description: The integration branch, named as into on every drop so it is never dropped.
